tone_tokens.spacing: Generous spacing rhythms using py-24 to py-32 for section blocks. Layout is contained within max-w-7xl.
tone_tokens.radii: sm (rounded-sm) for standard containers and buttons to maintain sharp, institutional look.
tone_tokens.shadows: Minimal. shadow-sm on light cards to lift off background slightly.

conversion_wiring.behavior: Form prevents default submission. Capture Full Name, Work Email, and Current Operating Stage. Should display a success message via Sonner toast.

content_slots.text: Practical education, strategic guidance, and a community built for entrepreneurs and owners at every stage.
“We're not here to teach you how to look successful. We're here to help you develop the knowledge, discipline, and capabilities to build something valuable.”

fabrication_guardrails: No invented stats, testimonials, student outcomes, credentials, or deal scenes.
No founder likenesses created/fabricated (use placeholder if needed).
No wealth-symbol imagery (jets, cars, cash, watches).
No generic handshakes or meaningless charts.
Maintain honest placeholders for any missing real-world proof points.

typography.headings: Fraunces for display headings with tight tracking. Use uppercase tracking-[0.16em] to [0.2em] for overlines and tags.
typography.body: Manrope for readability. Light to medium weights.
typography.links_and_buttons: Manrope, usually uppercase with tracking-wider or tracking-[0.14em] for institutional authority.

layouts.sections: Alternate between light ivory backgrounds with dark text, and dark navy/charcoal backgrounds with light text to segment content clearly.
layouts.grids: Use 3-column bento/grid setups for the 3M Framework and Course Catalog to emphasize equal weighting of the 3 pillars.

component_usage.buttons: Square or rounded-sm, solid accent colors or subtle borders with hover transitions. Avoid generic pill shapes to maintain an executive institutional feel.
component_usage.cards: Flat design with thick border tops representing the pillar color. Minimal shadows.
component_usage.inputs: Flat inputs with subtle borders, blending into dark backgrounds. Sharp focus states.

image_urls.description: hero: strategic operating review with business owner and balance sheet working session

instructions_to_main_agent: /app/design/direction.html is the visual source of truth. These guidelines transcribe it and add real images. On any conflict, the direction file wins. Ensure that the 6-Act narrative animation elements from the HTML file are replicated exactly as provided in the CSS. Preserve the data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx (if tsx) or .jsx
Ensure the application leverages the design system properly and creates an authoritative-editorial vibe.
